qualification.education_qualification: BTech/MTech in Chemical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering, M.Sc./B.Sc. in Chemistry
qualification.details: Associate Project Engineer: B.Tech (in Chemical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering) from a reputed institute or university with 3 years of experience or M.Tech (in Chemical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering) from a reputed institute or university with 2 years of experience. Candidates having experience in the area of plywood adhesive formulation, manufacturing and characterization will be given priority. Associate Project Scientist: M.Sc. in Chemistry from a reputed institute/university with 2 years of relevant experience preferred. B.Sc. in Chemistry from a reputed institute/university with 4 years of relevant experience required. Candidates with experience in plywood adhesive formulation, manufacturing, and characterization will be given preference.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Guwahati Various Posts Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 14-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Guwahati to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Associate Project Engineer: B.Tech (in Chemical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering) from a reputed institute or university with 3 years of experience or M.Tech (in Chemical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering) from a reputed institute or university with 2 years of experience. Candidates having experience in the area of plywood adhesive formulation, manufacturing and characterization will be given priority. Associate Project Scientist: M.Sc. in Chemistry from a reputed institute/university with 2 years of relevant experience preferred. B.Sc. in Chemistry from a reputed institute/university with 4 years of relevant experience required. Candidates with experience in plywood adhesive formulation, manufacturing, and characterization will be given preference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Guwahati Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 14-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Guwahati to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Associate Project Engineer / Associate Project Scientist posts is 14 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Associate Project Engineer / Associate Project Scientist?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the positions of Associate Project Engineer and Associate Project Scientist in the IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: For Associate Project Engineer, a B.Tech or M.Tech in Chemical or Mechanical Engineering is required. For Associate Project Scientist, an M.Sc. or B.Sc. in Chemistry is the required qualification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for both Associate Project Engineer and Associate Project Scientist positions will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 40,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, according to the official notification, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for these contractual positions will be based on an Online Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions of Associate Project Engineer and Associate Project Scientist are on a contractual basis. This means the employment is for a fixed tenure as per the project requirements.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Guwahati located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati is located in Guwahati, Assam.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any age relaxations mentioned in the notification?
faq.answer: The official notification does not explicitly mention age limits or relaxations. Candidates are advised to refer to the detailed advertisement for any specific age-related information.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official website of IIT Guwahati or the direct application link provided in the Important Links section before the last date, 14 September 2026.
